hero.subtitle: Whatever you're feeling right now — we're here with you. Slow your breathing and pick one small action below. This will pass. 🌱
hero.reassure: 💚 It took courage to reach out for help

hotlines.expertDesc: Book an appointment or chat now

breathing.title: 💨 Breathe to steady yourself — Box breathing 4-4-4
breathing.desc: This technique calms your nervous system within 2 minutes

breathPhases.completedLabel: 🎉 Great job! You've completed 5 breathing cycles!

detach.title: Step away from the environment
detach.desc: Find a quiet space, sit down, and place your hand on your chest.
steps: Leave the noisy space
Find a quiet place to sit
Place your hand on your chest, feel your heartbeat
Close your eyes and breathe slowly 5 times
Open your eyes and look around

stopDropBreathe.title: Stop-Drop-Breathe
stopDropBreathe.desc: Stop every negative thought and focus on your breath right now.
steps: STOP — Stop completely
DROP — Let go of every thought
BREATHE — Take 3 deep breaths
Replace it with: "I am safe. I am okay."

coldWater.title: Splash cold water on your face
coldWater.desc: Cold water triggers a reflex that slows your heart rate and eases anxiety right away.
steps: Go to a sink
Turn on cold water
Splash your face 3-5 times
Notice the cool sensation
Look in the mirror and breathe slowly

warmCup.title: Hold a warm cup
warmCup.desc: Warmth helps calm the nervous system and brings your mind back to the present.
steps: Make a warm cup of water or tea
Hold the cup with both hands
Feel the warmth through your palms
Breathe in the scent if there is one
Take slow, small sips

selfForgive.title: Forgive yourself
selfForgive.desc: Write down what you're blaming yourself for and let it go.
steps: Grab paper and a pen or open your journal
Write: "I'm blaming myself for..."
Then write: "But I forgive myself because..."
Read it aloud 3 times
Tear up the paper (symbolically letting go)

cryIfNeeded.title: Cry if you need to
cryIfNeeded.desc: Crying is a natural way to release tension — allow yourself to.
steps: Find a private space
Play soft music if you'd like
Let yourself cry naturally
Don't judge your own emotions
Afterwards, drink water and rest

grounding.subtitle: Bring your mind back to the present — tap each step as you complete it:
grounding.completedToast: 🌍 Great job! You've completed the 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding exercise!

see.title: 5 things you can SEE
see.desc: Look around and name 5 objects you see right now

touch.title: 4 things you can TOUCH
touch.desc: Touch 4 different surfaces — a table, a chair, your clothes, a wall...

hear.title: 3 sounds you can HEAR
hear.desc: Listen and notice 3 sounds happening around you

smell.title: 2 smells you can NOTICE
smell.desc: Smell the air, your clothes, or anything nearby

taste.title: 1 thing you can TASTE
taste.desc: Take a sip of water or notice the taste in your mouth

affirmation.hint: 👆 Tap to see the next affirmation

affirmations: All of my feelings right now are valid and deserve respect.
I allow myself to rest without feeling guilty.
I let go of things outside my control.
This too shall pass.
I don't have to solve everything right this moment.
I accept that I'm not perfect, and that's completely okay.
I breathe in calm and breathe out tension.
I am strong enough to get through this difficult moment.
I've overcome many challenges before, and I will this time too.
This pressure is here to help me grow, not to break me.
I'm capable of finding a solution to every problem I face.
Worry won't change the future, but calm will help me handle it.
I trust my own resilience and ability to cope.
I am in charge of my mind, not a slave to fear.
Right now, I am safe.
I choose to focus on the small step in front of me instead of worrying about the whole journey.
I am in control of my breath, and my breath leads me back to peace.
The past is gone, the future hasn't arrived, I live only for this present moment.
Every breath helps me feel steadier and more grounded.
The world keeps turning, and I have the right to slow down a little.
I choose to trust myself.
emergency.disclaimer: ⚠️ Important note: This app provides mental health support tools, NOT a medical service or clinical diagnosis. If you're in an emergency or having thoughts of self-harm, call 0931773637 or 115 right now.

safePlan.title: 📋 Personal safety plan
safePlan.subtitle: When you're feeling unwell, follow these steps in order:
safePlan.step2: Call a trusted family member or friend
safePlan.step4: Chat with PeaceCat or an expert
safePlan.step5: Go to the nearest medical facility if needed

peaceCatMessages: "I'm here with you. Slow your breathing — you're doing great by reaching out for help. Just take it one small step at a time. 💚"
"You don't have to be strong alone. Just take small steps for now. 🌿"
"This hard moment won't last forever. I'll be here with you. 🐱"
"You deserve to be safe, heard, and loved. ✨"

toast.breathingDone: 🌬️ Breathing exercise complete! Feeling a bit better?
